The bidder must ensure full compliance and attach product datasheet s for verification. 14. Declaration The bidder shall submit a self-declaration on company letterhead stating that th e firm has not been blacklisted in GeM or by any government organization during the past five years. 15. Star Rating The bidder must have a minimum of 4-star (LBL) final GeM seller rating. Attach a screenshot as proof. 16. Business Volume The bidder must have achieved a minimum business of ₹10 Crore or above on Ge M. Attach supporting proof from the GeM dashboard or order summary. .
